title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Tucson Convention Center, Tucson | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Tucson Convention Center in Tucson, Arizona, USA, on 3 June 2026.

It was the fifth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

George Harrison performed at the Tucson Convention Center, as it was then known, on 14 November 1974, and Wings played there on 18 June 1976.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Cut The Cake’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’

  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Overkill’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Africa’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’

  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
